cells.gaps: No sector policy is in force: instruments.csv gives the National ICT Policy 2009 (reviewed 2017) as replaced in 2021 by the National Digital Development Policy, which is classed national, and no sector successor is on record as adopted or in preparation. No evidence row gives the policy's text, period, delivery plan or reporting; the period is read as open because no end year is stated. The one governance fact (SLE-006, 2022-12) falls outside the 36 months and is not about this instrument, and nothing is dated inside the last twelve months. SLE-005 (2022-12) states the absence of a national ICT strategy, but stage 1 is closed because a national digital strategy is held.
cells.note: National ICT Policy 2009 (reviewed 2017): an open sector policy that a national digital strategy replaced in 2021, so it is lapsed and the cell is unplaced under the national strategy. Stage 2 or 3 would need a sector policy in force or a sector successor in preparation, and none is held.
